title: Small Compiler Subset BSBC Emitter Independence
purpose: Give BSharp Compiler Subset 0 its own BSBC byte encoder while preserving the production Ruby BytecodeEmitter only as a separate referee for exact binary parity.

allowed: adding compiler/small_compiler_subset_bsbc_encoder.rb as the independent Subset 0 byte encoder
routing SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCEmitter primary bytes through SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCEncoder
using compiler/bytecode_emitter.rb only on a separate referee path
requiring exact byte-for-byte BSBC parity against the production Ruby BytecodeEmitter
loading independently emitted bytes through the existing production BytecodeLoader
executing independently emitted bytes through the existing BSharp Virtual Machine
proving Profile 1 through Profile 7 compatibility without changing bytecode layout
forbidden_until_later_approval: routing normal BASIC# production compilation through the subset BSBC encoder

acceptance_rules: SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCEncoder must not require or call the production BytecodeEmitter.
SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCEmitter must produce its primary bytes through SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCEncoder.
The production BytecodeEmitter may remain loaded only for a separate referee comparison.
Independent bytes must match production referee bytes exactly for all sealed subset BSBC fixtures.
The existing BytecodeLoader must accept the independently emitted bytes.
The BSharp Virtual Machine must execute the independently emitted bytes with Ruby referee parity.
The v0.1.75 dedicated fixture must combine object interaction with numeric and IF/OTHERWISE meaning.
No Profile 8, binary-format change, full self-hosting claim, or Ruby retirement is allowed.
